root_guard_contract.release_required: Independent exact source and execution review, source hashes including driver/accepted core closure, exact request digest/nonce/boot and explicit remove-owned-terminal policy; no released request exists.

root_guard_contract.retention_scope: Successful build may coexist with cleanup failure; failed build may have honest proven cleanup success. Final receipt records both. No container cleanup is allowed absent new exact execution release.
root_guard_contract.reuse: Existing CliSignals latch, Docker client rundown, Lease acquisition, CommonExclusion acquisition, shared heavy acquire(kind=build), check_profile, inspect/retire and quarantine_root_lock; all four guard termination signals latched.
root_guard_contract.uncertainty: Partial archival failure releases none; any uncertain client/container/removal/archive/release/publication enters the existing nonreturning root quarantine, retaining remaining records and all durable archives. A crash/partial release is not automatic retry authority.
